verdict: Paid Instagram is delivering leads cheaply, but weak call volume and thin organic reach cap growth this period.
diagnosis: Instagram lead ads produced 298 leads at roughly $27 each this period — well below the $180 Meta benchmark for legal.

signals.headline: 298 leads at $27 each
signals.detail: Instagram lead forms drove 298 leads on $7,915 spend this period. Strong cost efficiency for a legal advertiser.

signals.headline: 1,521 landing page views
signals.detail: Only 20% of the 5,041 clicks reached a landing page. Suggests page load or redirect friction worth investigating.

signals.headline: 132 phone calls from Google
signals.detail: Google Business Profile drove 132 calls this period but zero direction requests. Intake speed matters more than location visits.

signals.headline: 80 reviews averaging 5 stars
signals.detail: Review pace is healthy this period at a perfect rating. Strong social proof for both local search and paid conversion.

signals.headline: 31 Instagram followers, 20 profile visits
signals.detail: Organic Instagram footprint is negligible. Ads run in a vacuum without a supporting brand presence.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.body: The typical cost per lead on Meta for legal firms sits near $180, with Google Ads closer to $325. Justice Consumer Law is running at roughly $27 per lead — a strong outlier for the category.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.body: Consumer debt and credit search demand typically rises in August as households reconcile summer spending. Legal keywords remain the most expensive paid category year-round, so intake speed matters most.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.body: In 2026, Meta's ad system selects audiences based on creative performance, not manual targeting. Firms winning on Meta pair volume lead gen with fast, structured qualification after the form fill.

recommendations.title: Test faster intake follow-up on the 298 new leads
recommendations.detail: Legal consumers hire whoever responds first. Consider a five-minute callback rule for form submissions to lift the share of leads that become signed cases.

recommendations.title: Investigate the click-to-landing-page drop
recommendations.detail: Only 1,521 of 5,041 clicks reached the page. Worth checking page speed, redirects, and mobile load to recover leads already paid for.

recommendations.title: Build a minimal organic Instagram presence
recommendations.detail: With 31 followers, ads have no brand backdrop. Test short weekly videos answering debt collector questions to warm cold traffic before the form.
